bindings.windows: UMDF/KMDF USB client or host-controller family; choose exact WDF model
bindings.linux: USB interface driver or host-controller driver; separate kernel binding
bindings.android: Linux USB driver plus version/vendor-specific Android HAL if framework exposure is needed
bindings.macos: DriverKit only for a supported USB device family and target macOS release
bindings.freertos: Board/vendor USB host/device stack and controller driver

virtualization: QEMU xHCI is only a controller model; a matching USB function needs a device model or controlled passthrough.
